law.law: Bangladesh National Anthem, Flag and Emblem Order, 1972 (P.O. No. 130 of 1972), Article 3 and Second Schedule
People's Republic of Bangladesh Flag Rules, 1972 (revised up to July 2005), rule 3

meta.name: Bangladesh
note: From the law: the proportion, the disc's radius and place, bottle green and red, and the Procion dyes, in the Order's Second Schedule and rule 3 of the Flag Rules.

From elsewhere: the law gives dyes, not screen colors. The hex, Pantone and CMYK values are the Album des Pavillons 2023's, as reported by FOTW, and the references are other reports on the same FOTW page.
Amendments: the Order was amended in 2010 (Articles 4A and 5), and SRO 38-Law/2021 replaced paragraph I of rule 4 of the Rules, on flying days. Neither touches the design.

dye: Procion Brilliant Green H-2RS, 50 parts per 1000
Procion Brilliant Orange H-2RS, 60 parts per 1000
